queries.query: What is the duty of care of directors under Canadian corporate law?
queries.ground_truth: Every director and officer of a corporation shall act honestly and in good faith with a view to the best interests of the corporation.

queries.query: When is consent required to collect personal information?
queries.expected_statute: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act
queries.ground_truth: Consent of the individual is required for the collection, use or disclosure of personal information.
